rows.note: Use this as the standard everyday choice when the bestseller is a book.

example.english: This bestseller sold out very quickly.
example.traditional: 呢本暢銷書好快就賣晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 coeng3 siu1 syu1 hou2 faai3 zau6 maai6 saai3

rows.note: Use this for a top-selling product other than a book.

example.english: This phone is a bestseller this season.
example.traditional: 呢款手機係今季嘅熱賣產品。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sau2 gei1 hai6 gam1 gwai3 ge3 jit6 maai6 caan2 ban2
